title: What Is Missing in Multilingual Visual Reasoning and How to Fix It

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the zero-shot and fine-tuned accuracy of various vision-language models on visual reasoning tasks across English and five diverse languages (Indonesian, Swahili, Tamil, Turkish, and Mandarin Chinese) using the NLVR2 and MaRVL datasets to measure cross-lingual performance disparities.

Evaluating models on culturally specific concepts and images curated by native speakers from non-Western regions (MaRVL dataset) compared to their performance on North American and Western-centric concepts (NLVR2 dataset) to identify gaps in multicultural understanding.
